keep_features.feature_value: Uses strong profanity and sexual/taboo insults
keep_features.rationale: Contains explicit profanity plus highly charged sexual and criminal labels.

keep_features.feature_value: Very high intensity of insults and compound list separated by commas
keep_features.evidence_span: "petulant man child, rapist, conman, traitor, felon and self confessed pedophile"
keep_features.rationale: A long string of condemnatory terms indicates maximal rhetorical aggression.

keep_features.feature_value: Targets a specific top politician as corrupt and criminal ("fascist in chief")
keep_features.rationale: Directly attacks a high-profile leader with ideological and criminal framing.

keep_features.feature_value: Direct appeal to audience to contact/urge Congress
keep_features.evidence_span: "Will you join me in urging Congress to support the Dream Act & deliver citizenship?"
keep_features.rationale: Explicit question requests action and specifies the target (Congress) and policy (Dream Act).
Focuses on immigration/temporary protection program and pathway to citizenship.

keep_features.feature_value: Advocates gun control as a crime-prevention solution
keep_features.evidence_span: "the best way to prevent these crimes is strict New York City-style gun control in every American state"
keep_features.rationale: Presents a clear prescription tying gun control to preventing hate-crime murders.

keep_features.feature_value: Bullet-point pattern describing sequential policy behavior
keep_features.evidence_span: "* Bad mouth government program" ... "* Defund program" ... "* Cancel program"
keep_features.rationale: Uses an ordered bullet list to lay out a repeated pattern over time.

keep_features.feature_value: Contrasts 'corporations scheming us' with 'undocumented immigrants' as scapegoats
keep_features.evidence_span: "not undocumented immigrants" ... "corporations scheming us year after year"
keep_features.rationale: Shifts blame away from an outgroup and toward elites/corporations.

remove_features.feature_value: Dehumanizing slavery/abuse framing toward political/economic actors
remove_features.evidence_span: "but to be a slave to the government"
remove_features.rationale: Uses moralized, coercive imagery to condemn the targeted actors.

remove_features.feature_value: Direct personal insult directed at a named politician (Trump)
remove_features.rationale: Contains direct targeted hostility toward a named individual.

remove_features.feature_value: Contradictory claims asserted as fact with repeated denials
remove_features.evidence_span: "They literally have not occupied Gaza" ... "They do not go into Gaza to murder and rape"
remove_features.rationale: Uses repeated definitive statements ('literally', 'do not') about actions over time.

remove_features.feature_value: Mocks outgroup with derogatory labels and 'We are not the same' contrast
remove_features.evidence_span: "blue hair mob" ... "We are not the same."
remove_features.rationale: Employs derogatory characterization plus concluding contrast to disparage an opposing group.

remove_features.feature_value: Claims an election theft operation 'so significant and complete' leaving no evidence
remove_features.evidence_span: "perpetrate voter fraud so significant and complete to steal an election"
remove_features.rationale: Ascribes coordinated wrongdoing with implausibly precise certainty and evidencelessness.

remove_features.feature_value: Opposes 'pride flags' as identity/attraction vs 'trump flags' as undesired class pandering
remove_features.evidence_span: "those pride flags" ... "while trump flags are just political"
remove_features.rationale: Uses a comparative 'difference is' construction to delegitimize one group and validate another.

remove_features.feature_value: Frames one side as oligarch-controlled minority that 'cheats' into power
remove_features.evidence_span: "Republicans are a minority that get cheated into majority power by oligarchs."
remove_features.rationale: Blames elites/oligarchs for manipulating electoral outcomes.
